title: The size pill says the key and the time while a hand is on a keyed layer
goal: The approved Animate a picture design shows a diamond and the time in the size pill while you drag a layer that has keys, so you can see where the change lands without looking down. The build shows only the size today.
notes: Follow-up of animating-a-picture-is-as-simple-as-setting-a-mo. docs/design/mocks/pages/picture-keys.html, Showing that a change will key. The other signals in that row are built: hollow diamond at the playhead, the pop, the panel row diamond, the diamond in Layers.
acceptance: Dragging, resizing or turning a layer with keys shows a diamond and the playhead time in the size pill, on a picture and on a video
A layer with no keys shows the size alone, as it does now
A walk at Next defaults photographs the pill mid drag
